ud7.9:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā mallesu cārikañcaramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena thūnaṃ nāma mallānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.
ud7.9:1.4: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito mallesu cārikañcaramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ thūnaṃ anuppattoti
ud7.9:1.5: udapānaṃ tiṇassa ca bhusassa ca yāva mukhato pūresuṃ
ud7.9:2.1: atha kho bhagavā maggā okkamma yena aññataraṃ rukkhamūlaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
ud7.9:2.2: nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi
ud7.9:2.3: iṅgha me tvaṃ ānanda etasmā udapānā pānīyaṃ āharāti.
ud7.9:3.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
ud7.9:3.2: idāni so bhante udapāno thūneyyakehi brāhmaṇagahapatikehi tiṇassa ca bhusassa ca yāva mukhato pūrito
ud7.9:3.3: mā muṇḍakā samaṇakā pānīyaṃ adaṃsūti. dutiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi iṅgha me tvaṃ ānanda etasmā udapānā pānīyaṃ āharāti. dutiyampi kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca idāni so bhante udapāno thūneyyakehi brāhmaṇagahapatikehi tiṇassa ca bhusassa ca yāva mukhato pūrito mā te muṇḍakā samaṇakā pānīyaṃ adaṃsūti.
ud7.9:4.2: tatiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi
ud7.9:4.3: iṅgha me tvaṃ ānanda etasmā udapānā pānīyaṃ āharāti.
ud7.9:4.4: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā pattaṃ gahetvā yena so udapāno tenupasaṅkami.
ud7.9:4.5: atha kho udapāno āyasmante ānande upasaṅkamante sabbantaṃ tiṇañca bhusañca mukhato ovamitvā acchassa udakassa anāvilassa vippasannassa yāva mukhato pūrito visandanto maññe aṭṭhāsi.
ud7.9:5.2: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhūtaṃ vata bho tathāgatassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvakatā
ud7.9:5.3: ayañhi so udapāno mayi upasaṅkamante sabbantaṃ tiṇañca bhusañca mukhato ovamitvā acchassa udakassa anāvilassa vippasannassa yāva mukhato pūrito visandanto maññe ṭhitoti.
ud7.9:5.4: pattena pānīyaṃ ādāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
ud7.9:5.5: acchariyaṃ bhante abbhūtaṃ bhante tathāgatassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvakatā
ud7.9:5.6: ayañhi so bhante udapāno mayi upasaṅkamante sabbantaṃ tiṇañca bhusañca mukhato ovamitvā acchassa udakassa anāvilassa vippasannassa yāva mukhato pūrito visandanto maññe aṭṭhāsi
ud7.9:5.7: pīvatu bhagavā pānīyaṃ pīvatu sugato pānīyanti.
ud7.9:6.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi
